02 / THE HUMAN BEHIND THE TABS

Hi, I’m Raphael.
I like connecting
unlikely dots.

☺Curiosity is
the common thread.

A bassline. A better school day.
A spreadsheet that finally behaves.

They might look like different worlds. To me, they start with the same question: could this feel better?

I build at the intersection of code, sound, and education. Sometimes that means going deep into a synthesizer’s signal path. Sometimes it means making a complicated workflow feel simple. And sometimes, it means hiding a game where you least expect it.

I care about what happens on the other side of the screen. The sound you hear. The time you get back. The little moment that makes you smile.

03 / HOW THE THINGS BECOME THINGS

Follow the
question.
Make it real.

✳
01

Get close to the real thing.

Start with the classroom, the workflow, or the sound. Understand the problem before deciding what to build.

02

Make something you can try.

Turn the idea into a working version. Use code, AI tools, and small experiments to shorten the distance from question to answer.

03

Listen. Test. Turn the dial.

Play the synth. Follow the booking through. Check the lesson. Keep refining the parts that matter to the person using it.

A little rigour. A little intuition. Room for a happy accident.
